interpretations: The circuit diagram shows a basic electrical circuit where the battery, switch, and both resistors are connected in series.
All current in this series circuit must flow through the switch, R1, and R2 in a single path.
The crop of the image shows a more detailed view of the same circuit components, confirming the labels and wiring.

image_metadata.educational_context: Basic electronics or physics textbook curriculum
